metric_evidence.quote: However, in the New York dataset, which presents higher coordination complexity, CoLLMLight8B outperforms all baselines, achieving a 25.17% reduction in AWT

evidence.quote: In the first experiment, all learning-based methods were trained on the synthetic traffic flow dataset, Syn-Train, and evaluated on seven real-world traffic flow datasets to assess their zero-shot performance.

practical_problems.note: Train on synthetic flow, evaluate zero-shot on seven real-world flow datasets; compares transfer against RL and LLM baselines.

evidence.quote: By utilizing reasoning strategies tailored to different traffic scenarios, our method outperforms the complex reasoning in most datasets while achieving significant efficiency improvements.

practical_problems.note: Real-time inference-latency obstacle: ablation of reasoning strategies reports travel time against total inference time. calibration: inference latency/efficiency is agent-internal, not a time series obstacle.

evidence.quote: propose a fine-tuning strategy that leverages iterative simulationdriven data collection and environmental feedback to build a lightweight LLM tailored for cooperative TSC.

practical_problems.note: Environmental feedback on queue length after a delay is used for refinement; the stage ablation measures score, not the delayed-consequence obstacle.

summary: CoLLMLight replaces RL signal controllers with cooperative LLM agents using neighbor spatiotemporal context, complexity-aware reasoning depth and simulation-feedback tuning; it lowers travel and waiting time, including zero-shot transfer from synthetic to real flows and a cost-versus-latency ablation.
